sections.heading: A — Exam authority
sections.markdown:
## A — Exam authority

The selected pages of this section cover the scale of the drinking-driver problem, how alcohol acts on the body, the implied consent and administrative revocation laws, zero tolerance for drivers under twenty-one, impairment thresholds, open container rules and the effects of prescription, over-the-counter and illegal drugs; they describe alcohol and drug effects and the related laws and say nothing about any examination; they state no exam name, question count, passing standard, format or time limit.

The run scope names the Hawaii Department of Transportation as the handbook issuer and the twenty twenty-three printing as the edition, but these pages carry no page-bound issuer or edition statement, so part A asserts no issuer or edition fact of its own.

Question count, passing standard, format and time limit for the class three knowledge test are not stated anywhere in this manual; every official exam fact stays unknown in this envelope and is never guessed.

Corpus note: the thresholds and revocation rules are statutory values printed in this twenty twenty-three edition, and the national fatal-crash figure is a statistic stated only as printed; no annual-rewrite signal appears on these pages.

corpus_stability.reason: The Hawaii Driver's Manual is a periodically reprinted reference (imprint HMG 5/2023, copyright line through 2023); the the scale of the drinking-driver problem, how alcohol acts on the body, the implied consent and administrative revocation laws, zero tolerance for drivers under twenty-one, impairment thresholds, open container rules and the effects of prescription, over-the-counter and illegal drugs rules on pages 55–56 are statutory and procedural content that changes less than once a year, so no BlockedProbe.
